message: The world checks the job and wakes you when it ends, and whenever it prints a line that starts with `HUTIAN_WAKE:`; your next activation says how it ended or shows the lines. When the world limits how long a job may run, your activation says how long; a job that runs that long is ended and you are woken, unless its resource keeps its jobs going. Continue work that does not need this result. If your next step needs it and it ends soon, `ht-resource wait` returns when one of your jobs ends, something you owe changes or its timeout passes; never poll it. When only a longer wait remains, end your turn; the job keeps running. `ht-role execution` shows recorded changes to what you owe during the turn.
